# accessibility

Use when the user asks for accessibility work.

## Workflow
1. Use semantic HTML and meaningful labels.
2. Audit keyboard navigation, visible focus, dialogs, contrast and screen-reader announcements.
3. Respect reduced motion and zoom.
4. Validate with automated checks and manual keyboard inspection when available.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
